slots.title: Every call *answered*
slots.body: Built to answer your business calls, understand the caller and book them in.
points: Books, or puts the call through

slots.title: Picks up when *you can't*
slots.body: On a job, with a client or after hours, the caller gets an answer instead of voicemail.
slots.label: Concept demonstration

slots.title: Knows what the *caller* wants
slots.body: A new booking, a change of time, a cancellation, or a message for you.
slots.label: Concept demonstration

slots.title: Books it in, or puts them *through*
slots.body: It checks availability and books a time. If the caller needs a person, it hands the call to you.
slots.label: Concept demonstration

slots.title: You choose how much it *does*
slots.body: Set it per business, and change it any time.
points: Automatic: it books on its own
Owner approval: it asks you first
Enquiry only: it takes the details for you
slots.label: Concept demonstration

slots.title: In sandbox *testing*
slots.body: Today the AI Receptionist runs simulated calls in our test lab. It isn't answering real calls yet.
